value.rationale: The underlying active-bound-state paper characterizes mean-square displacement and entropy generation for both Gaussian and telegraph nonreciprocal fluctuations. A natural mathematical identifiability gap remains when these physically different drivers are covariance matched and both published observables agree. Exact fourth-cumulant ordering for every lag, distinct fourth-cumulant short-time exponents, and the rational asymptotic growth-rate ratio give a structural and potentially measurable discrimination. This is an all-parameter classification, not a single arbitrary numerical slice or mere recomputation of an existing MSD.
